description: End-to-end metrics for one (strategy, scenario, seed) run.

final_min_rel_gain.description: min over domains of (base - final) / base
final_min_rel_gain.title: Final Min Rel Gain

mean_macro_loss.description: mean macro loss over evaluated rounds (area under the curve)
mean_macro_loss.title: Mean Macro Loss

max_spike.description: largest increase in macro loss between consecutive evaluations
max_spike.title: Max Spike

dominance_c0.description: mean influence share (projection) of the data-rich device c0
dominance_c0.title: Dominance C0

dominance_max.description: mean over rounds of max_k influence share
dominance_max.title: Dominance Max

dominance_c0_norm.description: mean bounded norm share of c0 (fair share = 1/K)
dominance_c0_norm.title: Dominance C0 Norm

weak_gain.description: mean loss reduction vs base on the weak devices' domains
weak_gain.title: Weak Gain

truncation_error.description: FlexLoRA: mean truncation error of the eval view
truncation_error.title: Truncation Error

title: RunSummary
